summary.implementedScope: Fixed SV-03-003 by making lower-band artifact persistence retry transient STORE_UNAVAILABLE failures in addition to stale revisions, with short backoff, so async detailed/brief background compression can survive file-backed mutation races without blocking the deterministic close path. Hardened the affected tests to simulate the verifier's brief-ready write failure and to assert the real nonblocking invariant without brittle full-suite timing assumptions.

changedFiles.reason: Treats STORE_UNAVAILABLE as retryable during lower-band artifact persistence and retries with short backoff so transient thread mutation failures do not abort background compression.
Injects the verifier-observed transient STORE_UNAVAILABLE failure on the brief ready write and proves scheduled async compression still persists detailed and brief ready artifacts.
Replaces a brittle 25ms full-suite timing assertion with the actual invariant that maintenance completes before the blocked provider is released.
